name: Get Cash
author: The African Boss

sections.description:
Improved shortcode output with eye-catching QR codes, buttons, and sales text, added a shortcode builder, live shortcode preview and a demo page in your own theme style like this
Unlock more great features for you and priority support with a PRO license. Upgrade

Receive payments, donations, tips on WordPress via Cash App, Venmo, Zelle, and PayPal with a button or QR Code anywhere on your website with shortcodes.
This plugin allows you to easily add a button or QR code to your WordPress site that links to your Cash App, Venmo, Zelle, and PayPal accounts.

For more details about this plugin, please visit The African Boss

See available screenshots and example shortcodes for details.

Disclaimer: We are not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or in any official partnership with Cash App, Venmo, Zelle, and PayPal. The use of their names, trademarks, and branding is solely for the purpose of providing a convenient way for users to make payments through these platforms. All rights to the names, trademarks, and branding of Cash App, Venmo, Zelle, and PayPal are owned by their respective companies.

Features to help you Get Cash

  • A shortcode builder and live preview at your disposal in the plugin settings
  • An example page with the most popular shortcodes generated for your eyes only styled in your active theme stylesheet
  • A QR code and/or a payment button are shown to your site visitors for ease of use. On phones the button leads automatically, because it is hard to scan a code with the phone that is displaying it.
  • Suggest multiple amounts with your preferred already selected, plus an “Other” field (PRO).
  • Fundraising: a goal bar, a supporter count and a thank-you message (PRO).
  • A filled, on-brand button with the wallet logo (PRO).
  • Free renders a plain outline button in your theme’s own color.
  • Keyboard accessible, screen-reader labelled, reduced-motion aware and print friendly – a printed page shows a large QR code and hides the buttons.

Example Shortcodes

Place shortcodes like these anywhere on your site:

[cashapp]
[venmo]
[paypal]
[zelle]
[cashapp qr=”no”] – button only
[cashapp qr=”only”] – QR code only
[cashapp size=”240″] – a bigger QR code

PRO adds more attributes and a better design and experience all around:

[venmo amount=”15″ note=”Custom note goes here”] – Venmo note
[paypal amount=”123″] – displays a button with amount
[cashapp card=”shadow”] – a bordered card with a lifted shadow (free always renders without a box)
[cashapp amount=”25″] – pre-fills the amount
[cashapp amounts=”5,10,25,50″] – suggested amounts, middle one pre-selected
[cashapp amounts=”5,10,25″ amount=”25″ badge=”Most popular”] – pre-select and badge an amount
[cashapp goal=”2000″ raised=”1450″ supporters=”214″] – progress bar and social proof
[cashapp title=”Buy me a coffee” subtitle=”Takes 10 seconds” label=”Support our work”] – your own wording
[cashapp thanks=”Thank you! Your reward is on its way.”] – shown after they tap through
[cashapp button=”brand”] – use the wallet’s own color instead of your theme’s button

[get-cash] (PRO) displays every method you have set up as tabs, with one shared amount selector.
[get-cash-form] (PRO) a request form that logs the transaction and emails you.
[get-cash-form amounts=”25,50,100″ payment_options=”cashapp,venmo” phone=”no”] (PRO)

Shortcode attribute list: qr, amount, amounts, note, label, title, subtitle, hint, thanks, goal, raised, supporters, badge, card, button, size, logo, class.

On [get-cash-form] (PRO) submission, the following events will occur:
1. The transaction is logged under Get Cash > Transactions
2. An email notification is sent to the admin, with the sender as the reply-to address
3. The sender gets their own copy of the payment instructions by email
4. The QR code and button for the chosen method appear straight away, with the amount filled in

PRO or customized version

Please reach out to theafricanboss@gmail.com for a custom version of this plugin.

Visit The African Boss for more details

sections.installation:
From Dashboard ( WordPress admin )

  • Go to Plugins -> Add New
  • Search for ‘Get Cash’
  • Click on Install Now
  • Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.

Using cPanel or FTP

  • Download ‘Get Cash’ from The African Boss
  • Unzip get-cash.zip’ file and
  • Upload get-cash folder to the “/wp-content/plugins/” directory.
  • Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.

After Plugin Activation

Find and click Get Cash in your admin dashboard left sidebar to access Get Cash settings

Also you can visit the plugin page for further setup instructions.
sections.faq:
What apps or payments do you currently support?

Get Cash plugin currently supports Cash App, Venmo, Zelle, and PayPal

Support

Premium Support

Users with a valid Get Cash PRO license receive Priority Support, directly from the plugin developer! Find out more!

Community Support for users of the Free version

For support questions, bug reports, or feature requests, please use the WordPress Support Forums. Please search through the forums first, and only create a new topic if you don’t find an existing answer. Thank you!

Languages and Localization

Also compatible with Translation plugins (like Loco, WPML, etc) meaning you can translate the Checkout, Thank you page and Email notices
sections.changelog:
4.0 Aug-Oct 1, 2026

  • Rebuilt every shortcode: a QR code and a real payment button together, styled appropriately, mobile friendly and accessible
  • Rebuilt the settings screen with a shortcode builder, live preview and a private example page
  • Added shortcode attributes: amounts, badge, goal, raised, supporters, thanks, hint, card, button, size, logo
  • Rebuilt [get-cash] (PRO) as a tabbed panel with one shared amount selector
  • Rebuilt [get-cash-form] (PRO) to match, with the amount first and no note field
  • Transactions now live in their own database table with a new Transactions screen: statuses, search, filters, admin notes and CSV export. Existing transactions are imported automatically
  • Added PRO settings for QR code size, colors and shapes, and Full-width Buttons now applies to every shortcode
  • Added Zelle tag and Zelle QR code settings
  • Added a currency symbol and position setting
  • Admin-only notices for unconfigured or PRO-only shortcodes
  • Fixed PHP warnings, and assets load only on pages that use a shortcode
  • New plugin marketing assets
  • Updated PHP, Freemius and WordPress compatibility

3.2.3 Nov 15, 2025

  • moved rest_api_init inside init function
  • Reduced browser console logging
  • Refactored code across plugin for better security, maintenance, performance, and compatibility
  • Moved third party libraries to vendor folder
  • Updated Freemius and WordPress compatibility

  • Refactored code across plugin for better security, maintenance, performance, and compatibility
  • Updated Freemius and WordPress compatibility

  • Improved class methods and functions

  • check if empty or isset for accounts

  • Updated Freemius to v2.5.10
